My name is Dr. Madankumar,  BVSc&AH, MVSc, a Post Graduate Veterinarian and I would like to welcome to my channel 
Dr. Madankumar Vet

We will provide all services in
-Establishment of New Dairy, Sheep and Goat Farms, 
-Technical consultency yearly, monthly or one time  basis 

Contact on Phone and whatsapp number: 9390116090
email: drmadankumarvet@gmail.com
      
These videos are uploaded to bring awareness among farmers. Before implementation requested to take help of concerned experts.
If some body has any issue regarding copy right or of such any, he/she kindly email us so we will take that video out .

Credit of videos goes to owners of farms and related one.
